# namesilo_privacy (Data Source)

Reads whether WHOIS privacy — NameSilo's PrivacyGuardian — is enabled on one domain. Use it to audit privacy state managed outside Terraform, or to gate other configuration on the domain's current exposure. To manage the state instead, use the `namesilo_privacy` resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "namesilo_privacy" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

output "privacy_enabled" {
  value = data.namesilo_privacy.example.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain whose privacy state to read, e.g. `example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the domain's WHOIS output currently hides registrant contact data behind PrivacyGuardian.
- `id` (String) The domain name. It is inert and makes `tofu state show` readable.
